approval.scope: All eight points approved unchanged from the reviewed draft r3-face-neutral-targets-v1-draft. The two browLeft points are approved as RECONSTRUCTED DESIGN, not as measurements of hidden pixels.
approval.statusNote: Only the owner may set APPROVED. Any correction is a new targets version with a new pin and a new owner decision.

coordinates: master canvas, continuous: pixel i covers [i, i+1); x right, y down

reference.readingMethod: visual reading on x8 crops with a 10 px grid. No automatic feature extraction from Northstar.

inner.definition: The brow tip nearest the face midline: where the brow's upper and lower contour meet.
inner.rationale: Agrees with the extreme column x = 534 (rows 266–269) of the existing D-159 brow component, which was derived by the published brow rule; the tip itself is a visual reading.

outer.definition: The brow tip farthest from the midline: where the upper and lower contour meet.
outer.rationale: Agrees with the extreme column x = 619 (rows 266–268) of the D-159 brow component.

inner.definition: As browRight.inner, on the image-left brow.
inner.source: D-159 provisional brow rule applied to browRight.inner: x = 2·510.8997 − 5 − x_R, y = y_R + 4.
inner.rationale: Northstar's image-left brow ends are hidden by hair. This point is a DESIGN choice (mirror + the owner-accepted −5/+4 offset), not a measurement of hidden pixels.

outer.definition: As browRight.outer, on the image-left brow.
outer.source: The same rule applied to browRight.outer.
outer.rationale: Hidden by hair on Northstar; reconstructed design, NOT measured.

top.definition: The highest point of the nose's dark contour line.
top.rationale: Inside D-159's nose box [496, 348, 510, 371]. Short span (≈ 22.5 px): ±2 px here moves the nose scale by up to ≈ ±13 %.

bottom.definition: The lowest point of the nose's dark contour line (base of the nostril curve).

left.definition: The image-left end of the mouth line's centre (the corner; the small end tick is excluded).

right.definition: The image-right end of the mouth line's centre (the corner; the small end tick is excluded).
right.rationale: About 8 px higher than the left corner: Northstar's smile is tilted ≈ 6°. A level mouth cannot fit it without rotation, which is excluded — the residual is reported instead.
